definitions.explanation: The process of examining the contents of bags or luggage, typically for security purposes at airports, event venues, or border crossings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{荷物検査|にもつけんさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I went through baggage inspection at the airport.

examples.japanese: ⟦{入場|にゅうじょう}→入場：03521_nyuujou⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{荷物検査|にもつけんさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a baggage inspection before entry.

examples.japanese: {荷物検査|にもつけんさ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{引|ひ}っかかって→引っかかる：12455_hikkakaru⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: I got held up at the baggage inspection and it took a while.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧ (baggage, luggage) + ⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧ (inspection, examination). Encountered at airports, concert venues, stadiums, and international borders. In Japan, security checks have become more common at large events.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {荷物検査|にもつけんさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to undergo baggage inspection
- {荷物検査|にもつけんさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to carry out baggage inspection
- {荷物検査|にもつけんさ}{場|じょう}: baggage inspection area
- ⟦{手荷物|てにもつ}→手荷物：09928_tenimotsu⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧: carry-on luggage inspection

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手荷物|てにもつ}→手荷物：09928_tenimotsu⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧: carry-on baggage check — specifically for items carried by hand
- {身体検査|しんたいけんさ}: body search, physical examination — inspection of a person rather than their belongings
- ⟦{保安検査|ほあんけんさ}→保安検査：19855_hoankensa⟧: security screening — broader term used at airports covering both personal and baggage checks
